facts.label: Platforms
facts.value: USB-C iPad with iPadOS 26 or later; Mac with macOS Tahoe 26 or later.

facts.label: Developer
facts.value: CineSpices, LLC. Created by Ike Arias.

facts.label: Video
facts.value: Two simultaneous live video sources, Reference Mode, video scopes, composition and focus tools, LUTs, and input color management.

facts.label: Audio
facts.value: Multi-source mixing, six audio scopes, and ITU-R BS.1770 loudness metering.

facts.label: Recording
facts.value: ProRes, H.264, and 10-bit HEVC on supported encoders, with digital slates, metadata, timecode, and a Media Library.

facts.label: Video input hardware
facts.value: USB capture devices on iPad and Mac; Accsoon SeeMo on iPad; Blackmagic Design DeckLink and UltraStudio on Mac.

facts.label: Availability
facts.value: Free download on the App Store, with one-time PRO Packs and a PRO Pass subscription.
